payload.title: Supplement
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook provides supplementary figures and analyses for a scientific study. It utilizes various Python libraries to process and visualize data, focusing on climate-related metrics. The notebook includes code for generating multiple supplemental figures, each illustrating different aspects of the data analysis, such as regression models, autocorrelation functions, and weighted means. The figures are created using data from CSV files and involve statistical techniques like linear regression and detrending.
goals: Generate supplemental figures for a scientific study
Analyze climate-related data using statistical methods
Visualize data with matplotlib and other libraries

section_blurbs.blurb: The section sets up the environment by importing necessary libraries and configuring matplotlib settings for figure aesthetics.
section_blurbs.heading: Supplement

section_blurbs.blurb: This section generates a scatter plot comparing different climate metrics, using linear regression to analyze relationships between variables.

section_blurbs.blurb: Focuses on calculating a forcing profile from SAOD data and removing volcanic influences from temperature anomalies using regression models.
